graph TD
  subgraph ci [CI Pipeline]
    A[Push Code] --> B{Tests Pass?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Build Image]
    B -->|No| D[Fix & Retry]
    D -.-> A
  end
  C --> E([Deploy Staging])
  E --> F{QA Approved?}
  F -->|Yes| G((Production))
  F -->|No| D
